taylor_marketing: Heads-up team 1: NebulaWorks case & quick launch assets. Goal: publish a short customer story + 10-min recorded highlight for the June 20 webinar. Need list: 1) 12-min interview recording 2) concise hero quote for landing page 3) legal release signed + logo SVG 4) 3 metric bullets (throughput, cost per inference, p95 latency). Customer wants to approve wording. Who owns sending release and chasing approvals?
sam_se: I can do the interview. Available Jun 11 morning PT. Will record, grab raw file and audio clips.
lina_content: Ill draft the case page and two social captions. Timeline: we need final approved text by Jun 16 EOD for design and QA.
raj_legal: Use the standard customer release template and cc legal@redwood.com. Confirm full customer legal name and the exact logo to be used. If youre quoting numbers, request explicit signoff from their finance team. Template: https://redwood-internal/release-templates/customer-release-v3.pdf
taylor_marketing: Draft hero quote attempt: "NebulaWorks saw inference throughput increase by 4x and slashed inference cost by ~55% after migrating to Redwood." @raj_legal any edits?
raj_legal: Suggest avoiding the word "migrating"; prefer "adopting Redwood's inference platform". Also avoid exact decimals unless they countersign. Use ~55% fine. So: "NebulaWorks saw inference throughput increase by ~4x and reduced inference cost by ~55% after adopting Redwood's inference platform."
taylor_marketing: Updated: "NebulaWorks saw inference throughput increase by ~4x and reduced inference cost by ~55% after adopting Redwood's inference platform."
sam_se: Recording plan  Otter.ai + local backup. Ill set up a calendar invite for Jun 11 09:00 PT. Contact: Maya Chen (ML Lead).
media-bot: Calendar invite scheduled: NebulaWorks interview  Maya Chen  Jun 11 09:00 PT  https://calendar.redwood/evt/99223344
raj_legal: When you send the draft quote & release, ask them to confirm: (a) authorized signer name and title, (b) logo file in vector format, (c) approval for the three metrics. Keep the approval email chain as the legal record.
lina_content: For the case page Ill need: approved quote, logo, 2 pull quotes, a short one-paragraph customer problem/solution, and 3 metric callouts for an infographic.
taylor_marketing: Sending draft message to Maya now (snippet below).
```
Hi Maya  Thanks for agreeing to chat. Draft quote + customer release attached. If you approve, well use: "NebulaWorks saw inference throughput increase by ~4x and reduced inference cost by ~55% after adopting Redwood's inference platform." Please confirm preferred logo (SVG) and who can sign the release. Happy to adjust wording.
```
raj_legal: Received. Ill pre-review the draft before it goes to customer. Avoid any language implying contractual terms or SLAs.
sam_se: Interview done Jun 11, recording uploaded to shared drive + Otter transcript generated. Link: https://drive.redwood/nebulaworks/rec-17491
lina_content: Got transcript. Ive pulled two 20s soundbites and a hero line option. Draft case page will be ready Jun 14 for internal review.
taylor_marketing: Customer replied: approved quote ok, finance confirmed the cost figure, signatory is Jordan Alvarez, VP Ops. They attached logo.svg. Ill forward the signed release once Jordan signs.
raj_legal: Great. Once we have the signed release, finalize the attribution line: "NebulaWorks  used with permission." Also save the approval email in the legal folder.

media-bot: Reminder set: publish checklist review Jun 16 10:00 PT

raj_legal: One final note: if customer edits wording to include exact figures beyond what finance approved, get finance signoff and attach their confirmation to the release thread.
